Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store

Class RouterStore

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.RecordStore<R>
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.CachedRecordStore<RouterState>
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.store.RouterStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
StateStoreCache
Direct Known Subclasses:
RouterStoreImpl
@Private @Evolving public abstract class RouterStore extends CachedRecordStore<RouterState>
Management API for RouterState records in the state store. Accesses the data store via the StateStoreDriver interface. No data is cached.
